title: Gold waits for the blind second judge before a build starts
pitch: Today a jury 13 on a self-improvement board queues a build at once, before the blind second judge (build 0002) has answered. Instead: a borderline gold waits for the second opinion; the build is queued only if both medals agree on gold. If they disagree the idea is marked contested in the panel and the Builds view, and waits for a human (who can still start it by hand). Gold set by hand builds at once, as now.
summary: On a self-improvement board, a jury score of exactly 13 no longer starts a build at once. It now waits for the blind second judge. A new pure function, goldGate() in score.js, decides what happens next: if the second judge also gives gold, the build is queued; if it gives less, the idea is marked contested. A contested idea gets a note in the idea panel, a toast and a ⚖ count on the Builds button. The Builds view lists it under a new 'Contested gold – waiting for a human' section with a 'Build anyway' button. Clear gold (14–15) and gold set by hand still build at once. Tests: 81 of 81 pass, including new ones for the gate, for the engine holding a build back until the second judge answers, and for the contested list in /api/builds. One older test expected a 13 to build at once; it now uses a 14, with no assertion removed. The live board has no jury 13, so the 'after' screenshots use scores set in the browser only, and the journal says so.

jury.reason: Closes a known open gap from 0002 (a 13 starts a build before the second opinion arrives) with a contained gate, but it is a small tweak with narrow reach.

filmLine: The app learned to stop and wait for a second opinion before rewriting its own code, and when the two judges disagree it now waits for a human.
tests:
✔ second opinion: only a jury sum exactly on a medal threshold is on the edge (0.196542ms)
✔ second opinion: the band spans both sums and says whether the medals agree (0.150958ms)
✔ second opinion: disagreement lowers the breeding score by half the gap, either way; agreement costs nothing (0.067708ms)
✔ gold gate: a jury gold on the edge waits for the second judge; only agreement builds (0.157166ms)
